crossRefs.note: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every…
and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore…
They left their images there; and David and his men took them away.

translations.web: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal, and burned them.
translations.bsb: They brought out the sacred pillar of the temple of Baal and burned it.
translations.kjv: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
translations.asv: And they brought forth the pillars that were in the house of Baal, and burned them.
